Examples # Click on an image to open it on full page.
Painted illustration of a full height character(s) in any pose.
Depending on compositions, some characters’ body part(s) might partially go outside canvas boundaries and / or be covered by other objects / characters.
Base Options # Base price: $40 Resolution: From 4000px to 5000px on the largest dimension Characters: 1 Background: simple background with some gradient. Gradient intensity might vary from almost solid color to high color gradation [Optional] Clothing: something like simple loincloth / speedos [Optional] Tatoos and skin marks: simple tatoos and skin marks with no complex patterns [Optional] NSFW: Dicks, cumming, masturbating, etc Additional options # Additional Characters: up to 2 $20 per character Max amount of character on a single image is 3 Complex background: $15 Complex background may include: landscape, landscape features, buildings, abstract silhouettes of some character(s) [Important!] The background still won't have any really small details Clothing/Armor: $20 May include any clothing/armor pieces If the character is fully covered by clothing/armor they still increase complexity. [Important!] If character's proportions are too extreme, drawing them in a full metal armor set won't be possible. As an alternative, it could be clothing with smaller armor elements. Due too "too extreme" being a vague term, you can ask me directly if you're unsure Tatoos and skin marks: $10 Additional references are welcomed, especially those that shows how it looks under different angles

content:
<- Commissions Info
You can contact me through EMail dagox.cdsh@gmail.com or through BlueSky DMs.
If you contact me through BlueSky DMs, then WIPs will be sent using MEGA cloud service, since BlueSky itself doesn’t allow sending images in DMs.
Usually I complete the work within a week. I never had queues earlier, so the description will assuming I already have at most one more commission or none at all.
Initial steps # You send me a message that you want a commission We discuss the idea, composition and details I'm starting to work on commission Work in progress # If there was at least some work done on the image during the day, I will send WIP image to you This allows to find any mistakes earlier and adjust understanding on both sides If some adjustments are needed we will discuss them Make sure to find any disperancies in our understanding as soon as possible. Later it will be harder to fix If the adjustemts are too late on the stage and/or too big I might add additional fee to the end price depending on the adjustments complexity Commission is finished # Once the commission is complete, you'll be able to make some minor adjustments Allowed minor color adjustmets of the whole image Allowe fixing of minor issues Once you confirm that everything is done I provide you payment link After you've done the payment, the platform will automatically give you access to your files Your files will be uploaded to the platform and to my MEGA cloud drive I might keep files on the cloud for a long time, but once I hit the space limit I will delete the oldest ones The list of files that will be included: Full resolution PNG file Full resolution JPG file 40% resolution JPG file for web Payment # Due to technical reasons, refunds aren't possible, therefore I accept payment only after the commission is complete If you're commissions contains NSFW elements, payment will be allowed only through Hippolink Hippolink doesn't accept PayPal, only bank cards and virtual cards As far as I know, even PayPal's virtual cards works, but not PayPal itself Otherwise will be used laval.top They accept PayPal, but any adult content is forbidden on their platform Cancelation # You may cancel the commission at any moment, until the work and payment are done If you cancel commission after I started the work, you would be able to resubmit this commission in the future to resume the work on it This will be considered as a new commission If prices were changed before you make a new submission, the end price will be adjusted based on new prices and the amount of work that was already done I may decline to resume the work on the old commission's work for any reason

<- Commissions Info
How you (client) may use the commissioned images # You can post it online You can use it for private, non-commerial usage and any other actions, that doesn't involves getting profit You can use it for personal, non-private usage. This includes, but not limited to: Use as a profile picture Use as a profile banner Use as a print, for personal, non-commercial usage Use as a desktop wallpaper If you transfer the usage rights to another person, this usage right will be applied to that person as well You are obligated to inform that person about this usage rights How I (Dagox) may use the commissioned images # I can post it online on any of my accounts I reserve the right to post high resolution images on any of my accounts I'll credit you as a commissioner, unless we've agreed for commission to be anonimous By default I'll use account you first contacted me, unless we discussed another one If you contacted me through EMail, I won't post your EMail address online. If you won't tell me any links to your account, the commission will be marked as anonimous If you want me to include different account's link you have to tell me what they are Notes # I'm not resposible for how you will use the artwork and where you will post it I'm not obligated to delete/alter my artwork or alter the description and/or links we've agreed after the commission is done and you have made the payment My artwork is NOT for NFT usage, AI training and AI Img2Img image generation

This page contains adults terms and definitions, no minors are allowed! Introduction # Some certain subjects might not be displayed here. If you're unsure about certain details, you can ask me directly. If I'll find it neccessery, I'll expand the lists.
In general, I'm pretty flexible, in terms of what I'm ready to draw, despite the fact, that my personal preferences aren't that wide.
Note Only things that that in “Won’t do” section I won’t draw. If something isn’t in “Will do” but not directly in “Won’t do”, I might agree to draw that. Keep in mind, that I still may decline it.
Will do: # Males Any species Unless it's in "Won't do" category Personal preferences are: Dargons, Sharks, Demons. Some ancient/mythical creatures and monsters are cool too. Athletic/Buff/Muscular body types Something like offseason bodybuilder and musclegut might work too. Any variety of dicks I didn't really have experience drawing most of those, that peole can imagine, but it's still will be possible Bipedal / Quadruped / Taurs Bipedals are ones, that moves on two limbs. That's, basically, the only ones I've ever drawn Quadruped are ones, that moves on four limbs. Usually refered as "ferals" in the community Taurs are creatures, that combines quadruped and anthropomorphic anatomical structures. [Important!] Quadruped and taurs characters has never been drawn by me, but I understand their anatomical structure, so it'll be possible to draw them. Additional references will be welcomed Additional limbs and traits Second pair of arms / wings or multiple heads / tails / dicks / etc are possible too Hyper Something like really big muscles, huge dicks, wings, massive horns, etc. But to a certain degree, if it doesn't break character's proportions too much. I know, it's still quite vague definition, so if you're unsure, you can just ask me Goo / Simbiote Did such things in the past. My preferences has shifter from that time, but I still don't mind it Female Never drew them, but technically, I understand female anatomy, so it's possible for me to draw them Additional references will be welcomed Won’t do: # Children The character must be physically and mentally mature. Even if it's ancient creature, that lived for several centuries, if it looks like a child and/or behaves like a child, it's still a child, no matter age SFW commissions are NOT exceptions Humans Humanoid races, that has more beasty appearence like orcs are fine Humanoid races that looks too similar to humans (elves, dwarfs, etc) aren't fine Round, ballon-like pectoral muscles
